content: The customer, Sai Kumar, contacted the insurance agent, Vikram Patel, because his auto policy (AP-001234) expired and cannot be renewed. Although disappointed, the customer asked for new policy options and recommendations for alternative providers. The agent offered a new, pricier policy with better coverage and agreed to provide details of alternative providers, which the customer requested to be sent.

action_items: Send details of the newly launched policy to the customer
Provide a list of alternative insurance providers to the customer
